# Research Square

> Research Square is a preprint platform enabling faster, fairer research communication with integrated peer review, professional editing, and journal submission services.

Research Square provides researchers with tools to share preprints, receive peer feedback, and submit manuscripts to journals. The platform partners with American Journal Experts (AJE) to offer professional editing and language services, and maintains an advisory board of publishing professionals to guide editorial standards.

## Key Topics

- preprint platform
- manuscript submission
- open access
- peer review
- professional editing

## Preprint Platform & Discovery

- [Home](https://www.researchsquare.com): Research Square homepage: preprint platform for faster, fairer research communication
- [Browse Preprints](https://www.researchsquare.com/browse): Browse and discover latest preprints across multidisciplinary research areas
- [Preprints](https://www.researchsquare.com/researchers/preprints): Preprint platform with open access, peer feedback, and journal integration

## Manuscript Submission & Peer Review

- [Submit Manuscript](https://www.researchsquare.com/submit): Manuscript submission workflow for creating and uploading preprint drafts
- [In Review Service](https://www.researchsquare.com/researchers/in-review): In Review service for manuscript submission and peer-review tracking
- [Participating Journals & Platforms](https://www.researchsquare.com/journals): Directory of participating journals and In Review peer-review tracking service

## Professional Editing & Manuscript Services

- [Professional Editing Services](https://www.researchsquare.com/researchers/editing): AJE professional editing and manuscript preparation services for publication
- [Rubriq AI Writing Assistant](https://www.researchsquare.com/researchers/rubriq): Rubriq AI-powered writing assistant for manuscript editing and language quality
- [Researcher Tools](https://www.researchsquare.com/researchers): AJE professional editing and Rubriq tools for manuscript preparation services

## Research Promotion & Visibility

- [Research Promotion](https://www.researchsquare.com/researchers/promotion): Research promotion tools including video bytes and article visibility enhancement
